answer: Honeypot apprenticeship limits sybils. First, each new identity receives 200 review tasks. Second, 20 of them are hidden forgeries with known verdicts. Third, the agent must flag at least 19 forgeries within 48 hours or lose its 15-token deposit. Fourth, survivors unlock reward payouts. Scaling to 10,000 identities means 2,000,000 reviews, roughly 4,000 GPU-hours at $0.80, or $3,200, plus 150,000 tokens locked. Picture a canyon guide who tests every hiker with painted fake trails. A hollow bluff fools careless walkers, and only those who spot the fakes reach the vault of rewards.
